 Actor Karan Wahi Clarifies Misconceptions Surrounding Past Relationship and Marriage Plans with Uditi Singh
 Television actor Karan Wahi has addressed rumors regarding his past relationship with Uditi Singh, clarifying that while he sought a serious commitment, they were not compatible enough to sustain a long-term future together.
 Zoom TV Digital 
 Updated Oct 25, 2026, 17:10 IST
 Television actor Karan Wahi has publicly addressed his past relationship with Uditi Singh , clarifying the circumstances surrounding their breakup and the speculation regarding their potential marriage. Wahi explained that when he began dating Singh, he was in his early thirties and explicitly seeking a partner with whom he could build a future that would eventually lead to marriage. He noted that his desire for a serious, long-term commitment was a personal priority at that stage of his life.
 Despite his intentions, Wahi emphasized that reports suggesting the couple had finalized wedding plans or were on the verge of marriage were inaccurate. He stated that his personal goal of finding a spouse was misconstrued by the public as an active engagement or concrete wedding arrangement. According to the actor, there were never any official plans for a ceremony, and the narrative surrounding their relationship had been significantly misunderstood by observers.
 Addressing Compatibility and Separation Factors
 Reflecting on the reasons behind their separation, Wahi identified a lack of compatibility as the primary factor. He maintained that while this was his subjective perspective on the relationship, he believed they were simply not suited for one another in the long term. The actor explicitly dismissed rumors that parental interference or external objections played a role in their decision to part ways. Furthermore, he noted that although their relationship had drawn public attention due to a ten-year age gap, he did not consider this difference to be the cause of their eventual split.
 Insights from Uditi Singh
 The discussion regarding their past has also surfaced through Uditi Singh, who is currently appearing on the reality show Bigg Boss 20 . Singh has provided her own perspective on the relationship, noting that the couple frequently experienced arguments during their time together. Her account of their frequent disagreements offers additional context into the challenges they faced as a couple, ultimately leading to their mutual decision to end the relationship. Wahi’s recent comments serve to finalize his stance on the matter, focusing on the importance of compatibility over the speculation that previously surrounded their connection.
